At 3-decimal display (the API has no unrounded field), private can only show signs, never a ratio. P(display != 0) is about |delta|/0.001, and v2 itself says one split can only fail to contradict the 1/6 rule, never confirm it. (4) THE PRIORS DO NOT FIT THE 1/6 RULE THEY CLAIM TO TEST. C5 P(!=0)=0.35 implies |delta| ~3.5e-4, about 0.4 of lp30's lab +0.00083, where 1/6 predicts ~0.14. C8 P(!=0)=0.20 compares with fm45 lab 0.0000/+0.0002, where 1/6 predicts ~0.03. (5) C7 RULE IS LOOSE. C7 = (e-a) - (d-#37), and each bracket is in {-1,0,+1} when |diff| < 0.001. Only |C7| = 2 with both brackets non-zero and of opposite sign proves non-additivity; |C7| = 2 via (+-2, 0) does not, and |C7| = 1 is rounding. (6) C9 HAS NO PRIOR, so as written it is not pre-registered. (7) C5 (lp30 on K2) nearly repeats C4 (leaf prune, P36 - #35), so the two are correlated, not two independent reads.
